faq-1: 1. Can you send a higher resolution image of the map?
faq-1-a: Yes, write to us at mapy@mzk.cz with a link to the desired map, we will make arrangements.
faq-2: 2. Is it possible to buy a map or graphic?
faq-2-a: No, we are a library, you can buy the original in an antiquarian bookshop. But we can send you a high-quality scan upon request, which you can then have printed.
faq-3: 3. I have an old map at home. Can you tell me what it is worth?
faq-3-a: Unfortunately, we do not carry out valuations for the purpose of resale. You should contact an antiquarian or expert for this.
faq-4: 4. I would like to offer you a map to include in your collection.
faq-4-a: Thank you for your offer. Send a photo of the entire map and its name data (usually in a special box or cartouche) to mapy@mzk.cz and we will agree on the next steps.
faq-5: 5. I am looking for a map of a specific place.
faq-5-a: In the top bar you will find the *Search* tab, click on it and select the area of ​​interest on the map. You can narrow the search result by the time range of the map's publication.
faq-6: 6. I am looking for a map that I cannot find in the collection.
faq-6-a: Write to us at mapy@mzk.cz! We will try to look into it with you.
